County Court of Larimer County – Fort Collins

The County Court of Larimer County, located in Fort Collins, Colorado, plays a crucial role in the local judicial system. As a fundamental part of the county court system, it holds jurisdiction over various types of cases and serves as a vital resource for individuals seeking justice in Larimer County. This article explores the functions, history, processes, and significance of the County Court of Larimer County – Fort Collins.

The County Court of Larimer County in Fort Collins, Colorado, is located at the Larimer County Justice Center. Here is the contact information:

County Court of Larimer County – Fort Collin

Address: 201 Laporte Avenue, Suite 100, Fort Collins, CO 8052

Phone: 970-494-3500

Fax: 970-494-3580

Introduction to the County Court of Larimer County – Fort Collins

The County Court system is an essential component of the broader judicial structure in the United States. The County Court of Larimer County, situated in Fort Collins, operates as a trial court with limited jurisdiction. It handles a wide range of cases, including civil disputes, misdemeanors, traffic offenses, and small claims. This court serves as a pivotal point of access to justice for residents of Larimer County.
